text:
The 12 s explainer is built. I checked it from stills and haven't played it back in real time.

- **Beat 1 (0–4 s):** nine tilted, colour-coded sticky notes with passwords like "P@ss123!" and "letmein!" pop in on bouncy springs, staggered. They jitter with a wiggle, and a pale shield outline fades in behind them near the end.
- **Beat 2 (4–8 s):** each note winds up slightly, then curves into the shield and shrinks to nothing, one after another. The shield fills navy and pulses on each swallow. The next note starts being pulled in before the previous one lands, so nothing hard-cuts.
- **Beat 3 (8–12 s):** a pastel halo bursts out of the shield, a white check mark draws on inside it, and **"One key. Every login."** fades up beneath. The halo fades to a faint disc behind the shield.

In the last-frame check at 11 s, the shield and headline don't overlap. The headline sits fairly close under the halo disc.

The jitter is on rotation only, with no position shake. If you want it more anxious, I can add position jitter and a quicker wiggle. I can also move the headline lower or tighten the shield and headline spacing.
